source: issue #1082 wiring (baseline measured with: godot4 --headless -s addons/gut/gut_cmdln.gd -gexit)
note: Ratchet ceiling for the GUT CI gate (scripts/gut_baseline_gate.py). Ratchet failing DOWN as per-suite fix PRs land; never raise it without team sign-off. Ratcheted down 2026-11-03 (issue #1770): the stale test_auto_aim_manager.gd::test_auto_aim_manager_has_targeting_methods pending id was removed from pending_conversions_issue_1361_followup - auto-aim targeting now lives in ShootingManager (get_best_target, get_target_position, get_nearest_enemy, is_target_locked, register_enemy, unregister_enemy) and that suite test now asserts the six-method API against production behavior; risky_pending drops 96 -> 95. Ratcheted down 2026-11-03 (issue #1771): the test_vfx_manager.gd::test_internal_methods_exist pending stub was rewritten against the real pooled-particle spawner (`_spawn_pooled_particle`, plus `_ensure_screen_shake`, `_trigger_crit_shake`, `_trigger_lightning_shake`), so risky_pending drops 97 -> 96. Ratcheted down 2026-10-26 (issue #1748): the 7 test_theme_manager.gd pending stubs were rewritten against the current ThemeMode API, so risky_pending drops 104 -> 97. Ratcheted down 2026-11-08 (issue #1772, applied at rebase): the pending test_object_pool.gd::test_object_pool_has_acquire_release stub was rewritten against the shipped typed pool API (get_*/return_* pairs, no generic acquire/release), so risky_pending drops 92 -> 91. Recount 2026-10-18 (issue #1667, measured locally, Godot 4.6.1): suite grew to 834 tests, 753 passing, 104 risky/pending. The single failing test (test_stage1_survivability.gd::test_enemy_contact_damage_respects_cooldown, pre-existing on main) is absorbed by tolerance=5; failing stays ratcheted at 0. Gate verified live and passing in coverage.yml godot-coverage. Previous baseline history preserved in git. Ratcheted down (issue #1794): the pending test_player_stats_manager.gd::test_stats_updated_signal stub was rewritten against the real production RPC path (get_player_stats() over a mocked NetworkManager that exposes is_connected), asserting that stats_updated is emitted and that it carries the RPC response dictionary, so risky_pending drops 91 -> 90. Ratcheted down (issue #1796): the pending test_network_manager.gd::test_send_rpc_timeout and ::test_send_rpc_auth_error stubs were rewritten against a loopback-only stub endpoint owned by the suite (a TCPServer bound to 127.0.0.1 on an ephemeral port, polled while the RPC is in flight): one mode accepts and never answers (exercising the RPC's own 0.2s timeout), the other answers with a raw HTTP/1.1 401 response carrying a JSON error body (exercising the is_auth_error flag). No production code changed and no live Nakama is contacted, so risky_pending drops 90 -> 88. Ratcheted down (issue #1795): the pending test_network_combat_integration.gd::test_combat_sync_integration stub was rewritten as a genuine cross-manager test against the ADR-0009 shared CombatStateCache - CombatSyncManager.start_combat() writes the snapshot and a separate CombatManager instance reads my_health/opponent_health/is_my_turn from it, plus damage propagation through apply_opponent_damage(40), so risky_pending drops 90 -> 89. Ratcheted down (issue #1804): the pending test_network_combat_integration.gd::test_campaign_manager_with_combat stub was rewritten against CampaignManager's real stage-based API (the manager has no _current_level/_level_data writers): a fixture campaigns_data in the production campaigns[].stages[] shape is read through get_stage_data()/get_enemy_data()/get_difficulty_tier() (stage 5_1, tier 3, enemy health 200), and complete_stage("5_1") emits stage_completed and marks the stage completed via the offline-safe local path. No production code changed, so risky_pending drops 87 -> 86. Ratcheted down (issue #1805): the pending test_cross_manager_integration.gd::test_gear_equipped_affects_combat stub was rewritten against the shipped gear->stats bridge (CombinedStatsManager): a fixture gear entry (bow, attack 10) is placed in GearManager.player_inventory/equipped_gear, a CombinedStatsManager instance is wired to that GearManager via its settable gear_manager property, and after recalculate_stats() the combined attack rises by exactly the gear contribution (10) while combined_stats_updated is emitted. CombatManager is deliberately not involved (combat damage is server-authoritative and CombatManager never reads gear; the mocked submit_combat_action -> opponent_health path is already covered by test/suites/combat/test_combat_manager.gd). No production code changed, so risky_pending drops 86 -> 85. Ratcheted down (issue #1803): the pending test_cross_manager_integration.gd::test_inventory_manager_with_store stub was rewritten against the shipped currency API, which lives in StoreManager (not PlayerStatsManager, which has no currency API at all): a mock transport answers armored_archer/get_currency with {gems:50, coins:500} and armored_archer/spend_gems with {success:true, new_balance:40}, load_currency() sets the balances and emits currency_updated, spend_gems(10) adopts the server new_balance (gems 40), and a GearManager inventory fixture (get_full_inventory()) co-exists in the same test. No production code changed, so risky_pending drops 85 -> 84. Ratcheted down (issue #1802): the pending stats/gear integration stub now exercises PlayerStatsManager.get_player_stats() and GearManager._load_inventory() through one local transport with the shipped RPC IDs, asserting level/stats and inventory/equipment signals. No production code changed, so risky_pending drops 84 -> 83. Removed the stale test_set_script_line_map pending ID because no such test function exists; this list-only cleanup does not change the measured ceiling.
